text:
maria_ml: quick kickoff — starting perf bring-up for veritas-14b (fp16, int8, int4 targets). primary goals: raw throughput (tokens/sec), p99 latency tail, and batch scaling curves across 1,2,4,8 microbatches. also need ctx sweeps: 2k / 8k / 32k.

sam_operf: sounds good. i'll own throughput baselines on P4d and A100 pools. timelines?

maria_ml: thanks. can you run these priority combos first: fp16 (baseline), int8-ggml, int4-ptq. use the small eval-rand1k prompt set (attached). aim for 1B tokens total aggregated.

sam_operf: ack. posting run commands so infra can repro:
```
# run script
rcli run-bench --model veritas-14b --variant fp16 --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --ctx 2048 --warmup 200 --steps 2000 --out /tmp/veritas/fp16.json
rcli run-bench --model veritas-14b --variant int8-ggml --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --ctx 2048 --warmup 200 --steps 2000 --out /tmp/veritas/int8.json
rcli run-bench --model veritas-14b --variant int4-ptq --batch-sizes 1,2,4 --ctx 2048 --warmup 200 --steps 2000 --out /tmp/veritas/int4.json
```

bench-bot: queued 3 jobs (job_ids: 39182,39183,39184) on p4d-cluster. estimated runtime 6h.

liz_eng: FYI, please capture kernel profiler traces (nvtx) and tokenization overhead. last time tokenization killed small prompts.

sam_operf: noted. i'll add --trace nvtx --token-prof flags.

raj_turner: for ctx sweep: recommend doing 2k->8k->32k but reduce batch sizes at 32k to avoid OOM. maybe batch 1,2 only for 32k.

maria_ml: agreed. also run a latency-first config (no batching, priority=low) to measure cold-start tails.

opsbot: capacity alert: p4d usage at 78% — please schedule off-peak 02:00-08:00 UTC if possible.

sam_operf: will slot int4 runs overnight per opsbot window.

maria_ml: QA/quality note: run eval set for quality (perp+exactmatch) after quant runs. flag any >2% relative drop vs fp16.

bench-bot: quality eval jobs queued (ids: 39190-39193). attaching baseline fp16 metrics once available.

liz_eng: if int4 shows regression, try layerwise-PTQ for outlier layers first. document prompt-level failure cases.

maria_ml: thanks team. action items: sam -> run the 3 variants + ctx sweep; liz -> token/profiler hooks; raj -> OOM tuning knobs; i'll collect results and create perf dashboard.

sam_operf: starting now. will post intermediate csvs to /s3/veritas-perf/ by EOD.

raj_turner: leaving a quick note — use kv-cache warmup script for long ctx. link: https://internal.redwood/kv-warmup

maria_ml: perfect. ping me when first results land. :thumbsup:
